# ADR-021: Retry policy

Status: proposed
Owner: firmware-team

## Context
Device protection threshold remains 250 mA; increasing it is not authorized.
The watchdog interval is 500 ms.

## Decision
Retry timeout: 250 ms.
The retry may stop earlier on cancellation.

## Consequences
No API changes. Board validation remains pending.

Source: docs/protocol-v2.md#retry
